evidence.reason: The drain deadline is computed before the loop but enforced only after the synchronous `drain_check` call returns. Because that call is given no remaining-time bound, one poll can consume the sum of its per-probe timeouts and cross the deadline before `now >= deadline` is evaluated; capping only the later sleep cannot bound that work. This is an implementation defect in the existing hard-deadline behavior, not a new requirement. The current tip still has the same unparameterized call.
